recap.title: Halcyon City 4-2 Redmarsh Rovers
recap.standfirst: Ezra Lazaro scored his second goal of the match in the 90+3' minute, assisted by Emil Ilunga, extending Halcyon City's lead to 4-2 over Redmarsh Rovers in open play from close range.

paragraphs.text: 11:55: Fontaine nets counter goal to open scoring at 12 minutes. 14:25: Isak Quarry heads Redmarsh level at 14 minutes. 51:59: Rask's counter goal completes Redmarsh comeback at 52 minutes.

By the 7th minute, Redmarsh Rovers have surged ahead in momentum, holding 63% possession and creating 3 box entries with a shot on target. Halcyon City trails with just 37% possession and no shots so far. Redmarsh Rovers have swung momentum firmly in their favor at 19 minutes, registering 3 shots and 3 box entries in the last 5 minutes while Halcyon City has not managed any shots in that period. The score remains tied at 1-1. At 30 minutes, momentum swung sharply in favor of Redmarsh Rovers, moving from 30.4 to -38.9. In the last five minutes, Redmarsh recorded 1 shot and 3 box entries, while Halcyon City had no shots during this period.

79:46: Ezra Lazaro heads Halcyon City level at 2-2 with 10 men down. 86:06: Lenny Amsel's header puts Halcyon City ahead with 4 minutes left. 90+3': Lazaro nets second to extend Halcyon City's lead to 4-2.

recap.player_of_the_match_reason: Ezra Lazaro was involved in 3 goals.
